data.title: Casa Bonay – Boutique hotel in Barcelona | Official Website
data.notes: Home desktop and mobile render-complete sessions inspected on 2026-10-04. A varied image sequence shows several distinct uses and spaces of the property; mobile preserves the sequence at a narrower width. Floating event widget obscures a portion of desktop; no interior page inspected.

data.principle: Lead with a specific working room and clear visitor tasks rather than a generic hospitality slogan.
data.observation: The complete home desktop/mobile sessions show a dining-room image immediately below restaurant, bakery, winery, shop and contact links. The page makes the real venue and visitor tasks explicit.
data.do_not_copy: Do not copy the pig mark, site typography, photograph, exact navigation, or sparse page composition.

data.principle: Vary image size and lateral placement to create a legible sequence of distinct subjects.
data.observation: The complete desktop/mobile home feed alternates narrow and wide images, left and right placements, and captions across multiple projects instead of repeating equal media rows.
data.do_not_copy: Do not reproduce the studio feed, particular image positions, project photographs, captions, or ratio sequence.

data.principle: Use small factual captions to anchor varied photography without filling every gap with promotional copy.
data.observation: Home feed captures show concise type/category/project captions adjacent to unequal images with substantial unfilled space.
data.do_not_copy: Do not imitate the exact caption syntax, project names, wordmark, or exact whitespace geometry.

data.principle: A sequence can establish a place through several real activities and rooms instead of one idealized hero view.
data.observation: The complete Casa Bonay desktop/mobile home captures show bathing, food, bicycle, garden, interiors, terrace and room scenes in changing proportions.
data.do_not_copy: Do not copy the mosaic arrangement, proprietary imagery, bright accent colors, navigation, or overlays.

data.principle: Preserve a purposeful narrative image order when changing from a desktop mosaic to a narrow mobile sequence.
data.observation: The mobile home session turns the multi-column photographic inventory into a continuous sequence with the property scenes still varied by subject.
data.do_not_copy: Do not reproduce the specific mosaic images, order, crops, labels, or responsive implementation.

data.detail: Heckfield Place, Ace Hotel and Apartamento HEAD probes responded; render-complete desktop/mobile sessions succeeded for STJOHN, DAVIDCHIPPERFIELD and CASABONAY. Availability may be transient.
